main_text.p: de oritur putredo. Sed Solis calor per se semper uitalis est, & rerum omnium procreandarum author, quemadmodum nos docet philosophus libro de GenerationeCap.9. & Corruptione secundo. Cum praeterea Fernelius libro de Febribus, capite decimo septimo, pestilentis febris causam esse perniciem, uenenatamq; qualitate e sublimi, coelitusque in aerem demissam, tum nihil probabile profert. Nam si e coelo uenenata qualitas in aerem demitteretur duo insignia consequeretur absurda, quorum prius esset, coelum uenenata qualitate esse praeditum: alterum nempe accidens sine suo proprioq; subiecto posse per se loco dimoueri. Atqui coelum nec uenenatum est, neque ulla qualitas per se loco moueri potest[?]. Propterea pestilentis febris causa externa non est aeris qualitas, quae e coelo promanet, sed potius ex cadauerum minimè crematorū, sepulcrorumue, aut lacuum ac paludum euaporatione, quemadmodum nobis ostendit Galenus libro de Differentijs Febrium primo.

page.notes: The word "poterit" or "potest" at the end of the line "neque ulla qualitas per se loco moueri po-reft" is doubtful; marked [?]. The "Cap.9." marginal mark is partly rendered in the scan and is read as "Cap.9.". After "primo." a small printed mark (a reference or printer's sign) follows; it is not transcribed. Line 7 of the text: "caufam" and "qualitate" are clear in the scan but show some ink damage. Word "quorum" and "esset" are somewhat blurred. The short underlined mark after "primo." is a printer's mark and is not copied as text.
